newsitem.title: DUBAI: King Hussein returns home after meeting King Fahd.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein returns home after meeting King Fahd.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan returned to Amman late on Thursday after meeting with King Fahd in the Saudi capital Riyadh, the official Saudi Press Agency reported.
The Jordanian king was seen off by the Saudi monarch and Crown Prince Abdallah at King Khaled International Airport, SPA said.
It said the Middle East peace process was the main topic of discussions between the two kings.

Jordan's ties with its large oil-rich neighbour were strained in 1990 when King Hussein refused to join Saudi Arabia and other Arab and Western countries in a military coalition to drive Iraqi occupation troops from Kuwait.
The two leaders put aside six years of bitterness last year when they held talks in August on Middle East peace efforts.
King Hussein who arrived in Saudi Arabia earlier on Thursday performed the minor pilgrimage of Umrah in Mecca.
